name: Antigravity-TS-TW
title: Antigravity Particle Field
description: Renders hundreds of particles in WebGL using Three.js and react-three-fiber. Particles orbit in waves and react to cursor position. Supports various shapes and customizable physics.
use: Hero sections with eye-catching motion, interactive backgrounds for tech products.
avoid: Mobile devices; WebGL performance varies. Old browsers without WebGL support.
a11y: Purely decorative particle animation. No aria labels or keyboard interaction.
